1.mascotDialogue: The pivot doesn't move again after partitioning — it's already home! Everything left to sort is strictly smaller on one side, strictly bigger on the other.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 9 places the pivot at its final resting index. Lines 16 and 17 recurse on the strictly-smaller and strictly-bigger sides — the pivot itself never gets touched again.

3.mascotDialogue: This pivot happened to be the smallest value, so it ends up all the way at index 0 — unlucky pivot choice, güey, and a good example of why selection matters for performance.

4.mascotDialogue: One character out of place — p instead of p minus one — and the recursion loses its most important guarantee: every recursive call's gotta work on a strictly smaller range than the one before.
